title: The leak scan's widened armor-line lookahead backtracks exponentially on a label followed by a row of Key: value cells
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits returns within a fraction of a second on an armor label followed by many '| Key: value' cells or '> ' header prefixes on one line, as the shape before 02ca8dc7d did, while every prefixed, escaped and bare key block the leak sprint's repros plant is still flagged

run: import sys,time;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon;d='-'*5;t=d+'BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY'+d+chr(10)+'| Key: x '*12+'|';s=time.time();kbcommon.leak_hits(t);e=time.time()-s;print('leak_hits on a 12-cell header row: %.2f s'%e);sys.exit(0 if e<0.5 else 1)

gates.question: How does the armor lookahead stop the header value and the gap from splitting the same characters?
options: possessive header value that ends at a newline, an escaped newline or a pipe
bounded repeat counts on the header lines and cells
gates.recommendation: possessive header value that ends at a newline, an escaped newline or a pipe
gates.answer: possessive header value that ends at a newline, an escaped newline or a pipe

notes: Found 2026-10-23 by the SP-evq2flqc fresh review: the header-line value and the separator group (\s, escaped n or r, >, #, |, //) of the widened lookahead in 02ca8dc7d both consume the same characters, so a failed match tries every split; timings N=8/10/12/14 cells: 0.008/0.13/2.1/34 s, the shape before 02ca8dc7d 0.0 s at N=12. No tracked file triggers it today; one that does hangs test_leaks, the publish scan, the sync gate and redact.scan. Operator 2026-10-23: fixed in SP-evq2flqc although S2, since the sprint introduced it in a critical guard; the review re-reads the fix.
